title: Adi-khanda, part 11 (portion 19)
html:
Kaishora-lila, the wedding (conclusion): the Lord at Vallabhacharya's house; the welcoming of the bridegroom; the bride is brought to the Lord, their first sight of each other; Vallabha honours his son-in-law and gives Him his daughter; the night in the bridal chamber; the kushandika, Vallabha's parting words; the return home with Lakshmi, Shachi receives the couple; a song of the Lord's strolls with His friends (1983 edition only)

Raga bhatiyari; disha: "Behold, my heart, the wonder: the Darling of Navadvipa, dear as life!" (murchha)

হেনমতে বল্লভ-আচার্য-বাটী গিয়া ।
জয় জয় শব্দ হৈল আকাশ জুড়িয়া ॥ ৯৩ ॥

henamate ballabha-ācārya-bāṭī giẏā |
jaẏa jaẏa śabda haila ākāśa juṛiẏā || 93 ||

henamate — thus; vallabha-acharya-bati giya — coming to Vallabha Acharya's house; jaya jaya shabda haila — cries of "Jaya, jaya!" arose; akasha judiya — filling the sky

93Thus [the Lord] arrived at Vallabha Acharya's house;
cries of "Jaya, jaya!" filled the sky.

শত শত দীপ জ্বলে উজ্জ্বল পৃথিবী ।
ঝলমল করে তাহে গোরা-অঙ্গের ছবি ॥ ৯৪ ॥

śata śata dīpa jbale ujjbala pṛthibī |
jhalamala kare tāhe gorā-aṅgera chabi || 94 ||

shata shata dipa jvale — hundreds upon hundreds of lamps burn; ujjvala prithivi — the earth is lit; jhalamala kare — shines; tahe — in that [light]; gora-angera chhabi — the beauty of Gora's body

94Hundreds upon hundreds of lamps are burning, the whole earth is lit,
and in their light the beauty of Gora's body shines.

তবে ত বল্লভমিশ্র পাদ্য অর্ঘ্য দিয়া ।
ঘরেরে আনিল বর মঙ্গল করিয়া ॥ ৯৫ ॥

tabe ta ballabhamiśra pādya arghya diẏā |
gharere ānila bara maṅgala kariẏā || 95 ||

tabe ta — then; vallabha-mishra — Vallabha Mishra; padya arghya diya — offering water for the feet and arghya; gharere anila bara — brought the bridegroom into the house; mangala kariya — performing auspicious rites

95Then Vallabha Mishra, offering water for the feet and arghya,
brought the bridegroom into the house with auspicious rites.

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু ছোড়লাতে গিয়া ।
দাঁড়াইলা পীঠোপরি উলসিত হঞা ॥ ৯৬ ॥

tabe sei mahāprabhu choṛalāte giẏā |
dāṁṛāilā pīṭhopari ulasita hañā || 96 ||

tabe sei mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; chhodlate giya — going onto the wedding platform (chhorla); dandaila pithopari — stood on the seat; ulasita hana — joyful

96Then Mahaprabhu, going up onto the wedding platform,1
joyfully stood upon the seat.

পূর্ণিমার পূর্ণচন্দ্র জিনিঞা বদন ।
তাহাতে মধুর হাসি অমিয়া-মিলন ॥ ৯৭ ॥

pūrṇimāra pūrṇacandra jiniñā badana |
tāhāte madhura hāsi amiẏā-milana || 97 ||

purnimara purnachandra — the full moon of the full-moon night; jinina badana — a face surpassing; tahate madhura hasi — on it a sweet smile; amiya-milana — blended with nectar

97His face surpasses the full moon on the night of the full moon,
and on it is a sweet smile, as if blended with nectar.

তপত-কাঞ্চন যেন অঙ্গের কিরণ ।
মেরু পর্বত যেন দেহের গঠন ॥ ৯৮ ॥

tapata-kāñcana yena aṅgera kiraṇa |
meru parbata yena dehera gaṭhana || 98 ||

tapata-kanchana yena — like molten gold; angera kirana — the radiance of the body; meru parvata yena — like Mount Meru; dehera gathana — the build of the body

98The radiance of His body is like molten gold,
the build of His body like Mount Meru.

অঙ্গদ কঙ্কণ ভুজে রতন-অঙ্গুরি ।
অরুণ-কমল করতল ঝলমলি ॥ ৯৯ ॥

aṅgada kaṅkaṇa bhuje ratana-aṅguri |
aruṇa-kamala karatala jhalamali || 99 ||

angada kankana bhuje — armlets and bracelets on the arms; ratana-anguri — jewelled rings; aruna-kamala — [like] red lotuses; karatala jhalamali — the palms sparkle

99On His arms are armlets and bracelets, rings set with jewels;
His palms sparkle like red lotuses.

সুদিব্য মালতীমালা দোলে গোরা-অঙ্গে ।
সুমেরু উপরে যেন গঙ্গার তরঙ্গে ॥ ১০০ ॥

sudibya mālatīmālā dole gorā-aṅge |
sumeru upare yena gaṅgāra taraṅge || 100 ||

sudivya malati-mala — a splendid malati garland; dole gora-ange — swings on Gora's body; sumeru upare — upon Sumeru; yena gangara tarange — like the waves of the Ganga

100A splendid garland of malati jasmine swings on Gora's body —
like the waves of the Ganga upon the summit of Sumeru.

মুকুটের নিকটে ললাট ভাল সাজে ।
কাম-কোটি কাতর দেখিয়া রহে লাজে ॥ ১০১ ॥

mukuṭera nikaṭe lalāṭa bhāla sāje |
kāma-koṭi kātara dekhiẏā rahe lāje || 101 ||

mukutera nikate — beneath the crown; lalata bhala saje — the forehead is beautifully adorned; kama-koti katara — millions of Kamas, abashed; dekhiya rahe laje — seeing it, stand ashamed

101Beneath His crown His forehead is beautifully adorned;
millions of Kamas, seeing it, stand abashed and ashamed.

শ্রবণে কুণ্ডল দোলে কি দিব তুলনা ।
দূর কৈল মানিনীর মানের বাসনা ॥ ১০২ ॥

śrabaṇe kuṇḍala dole ki diba tulanā |
dūra kaila māninīra mānera bāsanā || 102 ||

shravane kundala dole — earrings swing at the ears; ki diba tulana — what comparison can I give; dura kaila — removed; maninira manera basana — proud beauties' desire for pride

102Earrings swing at His ears — to what can I compare them?
They have taken from proud beauties all desire for pride.

হেনমতে মহাপ্রভু ছোড়লাতে আছে ।
বর উরথিতে তথা আইওগণ কাছে ॥ ১০৩ ॥

henamate mahāprabhu choṛalāte āche |
bara urathite tathā āiogaṇa kāche || 103 ||

henamate — thus; mahaprabhu chhodlate achhe — Mahaprabhu is on the platform; bara urathite — to welcome the bridegroom (bar-urati); tatha aiogana kachhe — there the married women [came] near

103While Mahaprabhu stood thus on the platform,
the married women came there for the welcoming of the bridegroom.2

করিল বিচিত্র বেশ পরে দিব্যবাস ।
হাথেতে উজ্জ্বল দীপ অন্তরে উল্লাস ॥ ১০৪ ॥

karila bicitra beśa pare dibyabāsa |
hāthete ujjbala dīpa antare ullāsa || 104 ||

karila vichitra besha — dressed splendidly; pare divya-basa — put on divine garments; hathete ujjvala dipa — bright lamps in their hands; antare ullasa — joy in their hearts

104They had put on splendid attire and garments;
in their hands were bright lamps, in their hearts jubilation.

আইওগণ আগে পাছে কন্যার জননী ।
বর উরখিতে ধনী চলিলা আপুনি ॥ ১০৫ ॥

āiogaṇa āge pāche kanyāra jananī |
bara urakhite dhanī calilā āpuni || 105 ||

aiogana age pachhe — the married women before and behind; kanyara janani — the bride's mother; bara urakhite — to welcome the bridegroom; dhani chalila apuni — the lady went herself

105Before and behind went the married women, and with them the bride's mother:
the noble lady herself went to welcome the bridegroom.

সাত প্রদক্ষিণ করি সাত-দীপ-হাথে ।
চরণে ঢালিল দধি হরষিত-চিতে ॥ ১০৬ ॥

sāta pradakṣiṇa kari sāta-dīpa-hāthe |
caraṇe ḍhālila dadhi haraṣita-cite || 106 ||

sata pradakshina kari — circling seven times; sata-dipa-hathe — with seven lamps in hand; charane dhalila dadhi — poured curd on the feet; harashita-chite — with a joyful heart

106Circling [Him] seven times with seven lamps in her hands,
with a joyful heart she poured curd upon His feet.

বর উরখিয়া ধনী চলিলা আলয় ।
শুভক্ষণ হৈল সেই গোধূলি-সময় ॥ ১০৭ ॥

bara urakhiẏā dhanī calilā ālaẏa |
śubhakṣaṇa haila sei godhūli-samaẏa || 107 ||

bara urakhiya — having welcomed the bridegroom; dhani chalila alaya — the lady went into the house; shubha-kshana haila — the auspicious moment came; sei godhuli-samaya — that hour of dusk

107Having welcomed the bridegroom, the lady went into the house;
the auspicious moment came — the hour of dusk.3

তবে সেই বল্লভ-আচার্য দ্বিজবর ।
কন্যা আনিবারে আজ্ঞা করিল সত্বর ॥ ১০৮ ॥

tabe sei ballabha-ācārya dbijabara |
kanyā ānibāre ājñā karila satbara || 108 ||

tabe sei — then; vallabha-acharya dvijabara — Vallabha Acharya, best of brahmanas; kanya anibare — to bring the daughter; ajna karila satvara — quickly ordered

108Then Vallabha Acharya, the best of brahmanas,
quickly ordered his daughter to be brought.

সুগঠিত সিংহাসন-মাঝে রূপবতী ।
অঙ্গের ছটায় ঝলমল করে ক্ষিতি ॥ ১০৯ ॥

sugaṭhita siṃhāsana-mājhe rūpabatī |
aṅgera chaṭāẏa jhalamala kare kṣiti || 109 ||

sugathita simhasana-majhe — on a finely made seat; rupavati — the beautiful maiden; angera chhataya — by the radiance of her body; jhalamala kare kshiti — the earth shines

109The beautiful maiden [sat] on a finely made seat;
the radiance of her body lit up the earth.

রতনপ্রদীপ জ্বলে তার চারি পাশে ।
বদন জিতল পূর্ণচন্দ্র-পরকাশে ॥ ১১০ ॥

ratanapradīpa jbale tāra cāri pāśe |
badana jitala pūrṇacandra-parakāśe || 110 ||

ratana-pradipa jvale — jewelled lamps burn; tara chari pashe — all around her; badana jitala — her face surpassed; purnachandra-parakashe — the splendour of the full moon

110Jewelled lamps are burning all around her;
her face surpassed the splendour of the full moon.

সর্ব অঙ্গে অলঙ্কার রতন-কাঞ্চনে ।
অন্ধকার দূরে গেল তাহার কিরণে ॥ ১১১ ॥

sarba aṅge alaṅkāra ratana-kāñcane |
andhakāra dūre gela tāhāra kiraṇe || 111 ||

sarva ange alankara — ornaments on all her body; ratana-kanchane — of jewels and gold; andhakara dure gela — the darkness went far away; tahara kirane — by their radiance

111On all her body were ornaments of jewels and gold;
their radiance drove the darkness away.

প্রভু প্রদক্ষিণ করি ফিরে সাতবার ।
করজোড় করি শিরে করে নমস্কার ॥ ১১২ ॥

prabhu pradakṣiṇa kari phire sātabāra |
karajoṛa kari śire kare namaskāra || 112 ||

prabhu pradakshina kari — circling the Lord; phire satabara — goes round seven times; karajoda kari shire — joining her palms at her head; kare namaskara — bows

112Circling the Lord seven times,
[the bride], joining her palms at her head, bows to Him.

অন্তঃপট ঘুচাইল দোঁহে দোঁহা দেখি ।
দোঁহে দোঁহা দেখি দোঁহার নাচয়ে দু আঁখি ॥ ১১৩ ॥

antaḥpaṭa ghucāila doṁhe doṁhā dekhi |
doṁhe doṁhā dekhi doṁhāra nācaẏe du āṁkhi || 113 ||

antahpata ghuchaila — the screening cloth was removed; donhe donha dekhi — the two saw each other; donhe donha dekhi — seeing each other; donhara nachaye du ankhi — the eyes of both dance

113The cloth that screened them was removed, and they saw each other;
they gaze at each other — and the eyes of both are dancing.

চন্দ্র রোহিণী যেন একত্র মিলন ।
অন্যোন্যে করয়ে দোঁহে কুসুমের রণ ॥ ১১৪ ॥

candra rohiṇī yena ekatra milana |
anyonye karaẏe doṁhe kusumera raṇa || 114 ||

chandra rohini yena — like the Moon and Rohini; ekatra milana — meeting together; anyonye karaye donhe — the two wage with each other; kusumera rana — a duel of flowers

114As if the Moon and Rohini had met together:4
the two shower each other with flowers, as if in a duel.

যেন হরপার্বতী দোঁহে হৈলা মেলা ।
ছামুনি নাড়িল দোঁহে আনন্দে বিভোলা ॥ ১১৫ ॥

yena harapārbatī doṁhe hailā melā |
chāmuni nāṛila doṁhe ānande bibholā || 115 ||

yena hara-parvati — like Hara and Parvati; donhe haila mela — the two met; chhamuni nadila donhe — both waved the chhamuni; anande vibhola — beside themselves with bliss

115Like Hara and Parvati — so the two met;
both, beside themselves with bliss, waved the chhamuni.5

চতুর্দিকে জয়ধ্বনি হরি হরি নাদ ।
নাচয়ে সকল লোক হরিষে উন্মাদ ॥ ১১৬ ॥

caturdike jaẏadhbani hari hari nāda |
nācaẏe sakala loka hariṣe unmāda || 116 ||

chaturdike — on all sides; jaya-dhvani — cries of "Jaya!"; hari hari nada — shouts of "Hari, Hari!"; nachaye sakala loka — all the people dance; harishe unmada — mad with joy

116On all sides are cries of "Jaya!" and shouts of "Hari, Hari!";
all the people dance, mad with joy.

তবে সে কমলাপতি বিশ্বম্ভর পহুঁ ।
একত্রে বসিলা বামপাশে করি বহু ॥ ১১৭ ॥

tabe se kamalāpati biśbambhara pahuṁ |
ekatre basilā bāmapāśe kari bahu || 117 ||

tabe se — then; kamalapati — the Lord of Kamala; vishvambhara pahun — Lord Vishvambhara; ekatre basila — sat together; vama-pashe kari bahu — placing the bride at His left

117Then the Lord of Kamala, Lord Vishvambhara,
sat down, seating the bride at His left.

লজ্জা-নম্রমুখী সে বসিলা পহুঁ-কাছে ।
জামাতা পূজয়ে মিশ্র যে বিধান আছে ॥ ১১৮ ॥

lajjā-namramukhī se basilā pahuṁ-kāche |
jāmātā pūjaẏe miśra ye bidhāna āche || 118 ||

lajja-namra-mukhi se — she, her face bowed in shyness; basila pahun-kachhe — sat near the Lord; jamata pujaye mishra — Mishra honours his son-in-law; ye vidhana achhe — as is prescribed

118Her face bowed in shyness, she sat beside the Lord;
and Mishra honours his son-in-law according to all the rules.

যার পাদপদ্মে ব্রহ্মা পাদ্য নিবেদিয়া ।
সৃষ্টির করতা হৈল প্রসাদ পাইয়া ॥ ১১৯ ॥

yāra pādapadme brahmā pādya nibediẏā |
sṛṣṭira karatā haila prasāda pāiẏā || 119 ||

yara pada-padme — to whose lotus feet; brahma padya nivediya — Brahma, offering water for the feet; srishtira karata haila — became the creator of the world; prasada paiya — obtaining grace

119He to whose lotus feet Brahma offered water
and by whose grace became the creator of the world;6

যে পদ হইতে গঙ্গা আইলা মহীতলে ।
সর্বলোক মুক্তিপদ পাইল সেকালে ॥ ১২০ ॥

ye pada haite gaṅgā āilā mahītale |
sarbaloka muktipada pāila sekāle || 120 ||

ye pada haite — from which foot; ganga aila mahitale — the Ganga came down to earth; sarva-loka — all the worlds; mukti-pada paila — attained liberation; sekale — at that time

120He from whose foot the Ganga came down to the earth,7
and at that time all the worlds attained liberation;

যাহারে ত্রিপাদ-ভূমি উৎসর্গিল বলি ।
তাহার মস্তকে দিলা পাদপদ্ম-ধূলি ॥ ১২১ ॥

yāhāre tripāda-bhūmi utsargila bali |
tāhāra mastake dilā pādapadma-dhūli || 121 ||

yahare — to whom; tripada-bhumi utsargila bali — Bali gave three steps of land; tahara mastake — on his head; dila pada-padma-dhuli — placed the dust of the lotus feet

121He to whom Bali gave three steps of land
and on whose head He placed the dust of His lotus feet;

যে পদ জপিয়া যোগী হৈলা মহেশ্বর ।
যেই পদ আনন্দে কমলা-দেবী সেবে ॥ ১২২ ॥

ye pada japiẏā yogī hailā maheśbara |
yei pada ānande kamalā-debī sebe || 122 ||

ye pada japiya — by repeating [the name of] which foot; yogi haila maheshvara — the yogi became Maheshvara; yei pada — that foot; anande kamala-devi seve — the goddess Kamala serves with joy

122That foot by repeating [the name of] which the yogi became Maheshvara,
that foot which the goddess Kamala serves with joy;

তাহা হইতে বিষ্ণু যার অংশ অবতার ।
যার অংশ আদিবরাহ পৃথিবী-উদ্ধার ॥ ১২৩ ॥

tāhā haite biṣṇu yāra aṃśa abatāra |
yāra aṃśa ādibarāha pṛthibī-uddhāra || 123 ||

taha haite — from Him; vishnu — Vishnu; yara amsha avatara — His partial avatara; yara amsha — whose portion; adi-varaha — Adi-Varaha; prithivi-uddhara — the raiser of the earth

123He from whom comes Vishnu, His partial avatara;
whose portion is Adi-Varaha, who raised up the earth;

যার অংশ মৎস্য-কূর্ম-বরাহ-নৃসিংহাদি ।
হিরণ্যকশিপু-বামন-ম্লেচ্ছ প্রভৃতি ॥ ১২৪ ॥

yāra aṃśa matsya-kūrma-barāha-nṛsiṃhādi |
hiraṇyakaśipu-bāmana-mleccha prabhṛti || 124 ||

yara amsha — whose portions; matsya-kurma-varaha-nrisimha-adi — Matsya, Kurma, Varaha, Nrisimha and others; hiranyakashipu — [the Slayer of] Hiranyakashipu; vamana — Vamana; mleccha — [the Chastiser of] the mlecchas; prabhriti — and the rest

124whose portions are Matsya, Kurma, Varaha, Nrisimha and the others,
[the Slayer of] Hiranyakashipu, Vamana, [the Chastiser of] the mlecchas and the rest;

পরশুরাম-ভৃগুরাম-বৌদ্ধ-ব্যাসমুনি ।
অষ্টাদশ পুরাণ যাহার মুখে শুনি ॥ ১২৫ ॥

paraśurāma-bhṛgurāma-bauddha-byāsamuni |
aṣṭādaśa purāṇa yāhāra mukhe śuni || 125 ||

parashurama — Parashurama; bhrigurama — Bhrigurama; bauddha — Buddha; vyasa-muni — the sage Vyasa; ashtadasha purana — the eighteen Puranas; yahara mukhe shuni — heard from whose lips

125Parashurama, Bhrigurama, Buddha, the sage Vyasa,
from whose lips the eighteen Puranas are heard8 —

এই শুন গুণগাথা দশ অবতার ।
যুগে যুগে অবতার জীব তরাবার ॥ ১২৬ ॥

ei śuna guṇagāthā daśa abatāra |
yuge yuge abatāra jība tarābāra || 126 ||

ei shuna guna-gatha — hear this song of virtues; dasha avatara — of the ten avataras; yuge yuge avatara — descending age after age; jiva tarabara — to deliver the souls

126hear now this song of the virtues of the ten avataras,
who descend age after age to deliver the souls —

সে প্রভু হইলা বল্লভাচার্যের জামাতা ।
ত্রিভুবনে যাহার ভাগ্যের নাহি কথা ॥ ১২৭ ॥

se prabhu hailā ballabhācāryera jāmātā |
tribhubane yāhāra bhāgyera nāhi kathā || 127 ||

se prabhu haila — that Lord became; vallabhacharyera jamata — Vallabhacharya's son-in-law; tribhuvane — in the three worlds; yahara bhagyera nahi katha — there are no words for his fortune

127that Lord became Vallabhacharya's son-in-law;
in all the three worlds there are no words for his good fortune.

গৌরাঙ্গের গুণগাথা অমৃতের খণ্ড ।
যে কথা শুনিলে ঘুচে অন্তর-পাষণ্ড ॥ ১২৮ ॥

gaurāṅgera guṇagāthā amṛtera khaṇḍa |
ye kathā śunile ghuce antara-pāṣaṇḍa || 128 ||

gaurangera guna-gatha — the song of Gauranga's virtues; amritera khanda — a morsel of nectar; ye katha shunile — when one hears this account; ghuche antara-pashanda — godlessness leaves the heart

128The song of Gauranga's virtues is a morsel of nectar:
whoever hears it, from his heart godlessness departs.

হেন সে পদারবিন্দে পাদ্য দেই মিশ্র ।
যার আরাধনে ঘুচে সংসার-তমিস্র ॥ ১২৯ ॥

hena se padārabinde pādya dei miśra |
yāra ārādhane ghuce saṃsāra-tamisra || 129 ||

hena se padaravinde — to such lotus feet; padya dei mishra — Mishra offers water; yara aradhane — by whose worship; ghuche samsara-tamisra — the darkness of samsara is dispelled

129To such lotus feet Mishra offers water —
feet whose worship dispels the darkness of samsara.

মহেন্দ্র যাহারে দিল নৃপ-সিংহাসন ।
হেন জনে দেই মিশ্র বিষ্টর-আসন ॥ ১৩০ ॥

mahendra yāhāre dila nṛpa-siṃhāsana |
hena jane dei miśra biṣṭara-āsana || 130 ||

mahendra yahare dila — to whom great Indra gave; nripa-simhasana — the royal throne; hena jane — to such a Person; dei mishra — Mishra gives; vishtara-asana — a seat of grass (vishtara)

130To Him to whom great Indra yielded his royal throne,9
Mishra gives a seat — a mat of grass.

যে প্রভু বসন পরে দিব্য-পীতবাস ।
তাহারে বসন দেই শুনিতে তরাস ॥ ১৩১ ॥

ye prabhu basana pare dibya-pītabāsa |
tāhāre basana dei śunite tarāsa || 131 ||

ye prabhu basana pare — the Lord who wears as garment; divya-pita-basa — divine yellow cloth; tahare basana dei — to Him he gives a garment; shunite tarasa — fearful to hear

131To the Lord who is clad in divine yellow garments
he gives a garment — it is fearful even to hear!

এই মনে ক্রমে ক্রমে যে বিধি আছিল ।
যজ্ঞ আদি যত কর্ম সব নিবড়িল ॥ ১৩২ ॥

ei mane krame krame ye bidhi āchila |
yajña ādi yata karma saba nibaṛila || 132 ||

ei mane — thus; krame krame — in due order; ye vidhi achhila — what was prescribed; yajna adi yata karma — the sacrifice and all the rites; saba nibadila — all was completed

132Thus, in due order, all that was prescribed —
the sacrifice and all the other rites — was completed.

বল্লভ আচার্য হেন নাহি ভাগ্যবান্ ।
আপনে বৈকুণ্ঠনাথ লৈল কন্যাদান ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

ballabha ācārya hena nāhi bhāgyabān |
āpane baikuṇṭhanātha laila kanyādāna || 133 ||

vallabha acharya hena — like Vallabha Acharya; nahi bhagyavan — there is none so fortunate; apane — Himself; vaikuntha-natha — the Lord of Vaikuntha; laila kanya-dana — accepted the gift of the daughter

133No one is as fortunate as Vallabha Acharya:
the Lord of Vaikuntha Himself accepted his daughter as a gift.

কি কহিব বল্লভমিশ্রের ভাগ্যরাশি ।
যার ঘরে কৈলা প্রভু এ পঞ্চ-গরাসি ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

ki kahiba ballabhamiśrera bhāgyarāśi |
yāra ghare kailā prabhu e pañca-garāsi || 134 ||

ki kahiba — what shall I say; vallabha-mishrera bhagya-rashi — of Vallabha Mishra's heap of fortune; yara ghare — in whose house; kaila prabhu — the Lord performed; e pancha-garasi — this rite of the five mouthfuls

134What can I say of the boundless good fortune of Vallabha Mishra,
in whose house the Lord performed the rite of the five mouthfuls!10

কন্যা-বরে একগৃহে ভোজন করিল ।
শত শত কুলবধূ বাসরে মিলিল ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

kanyā-bare ekagṛhe bhojana karila |
śata śata kulabadhū bāsare milila || 135 ||

kanya-bare — bride and bridegroom; eka-grihe — in one room; bhojana karila — took their meal; shata shata kula-badhu — hundreds upon hundreds of noble wives; basare milila — gathered in the bridal chamber

135Bride and bridegroom took their meal in one room;
hundreds upon hundreds of wives of noble families gathered in the bridal chamber.11

যূথে যূথে তরুণী আইল প্রভু-কাছে ।
বেঢ়িয়া রহিল বিশ্বম্ভর আগে পাছে ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

yūthe yūthe taruṇī āila prabhu-kāche |
beṛhiẏā rahila biśbambhara āge pāche || 136 ||

yuthe yuthe taruni — young women in throngs; aila prabhu-kachhe — came to the Lord; bedhiya rahila — surrounded; vishvambhara age pachhe — Vishvambhara in front and behind

136In throngs the young women came to the Lord
and surrounded Vishvambhara in front and behind.

সে চন্দ্রবদন-হাস্য উদয় দেখিয়া ।
লজ্জা-তিমির সভার গেল পলাইয়া ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

se candrabadana-hāsya udaẏa dekhiẏā |
lajjā-timira sabhāra gela palāiẏā || 137 ||

se chandra-badana-hasya — of the smile on that moonlike face; udaya dekhiya — seeing the rising; lajja-timira — the darkness of shyness; sabhara — of all; gela palaiya — fled away

137Seeing the rising of the smile on His moonlike face,
the darkness of everyone's shyness fled away.

বসিলা সুন্দরী সব প্রভুর সমীপে ।
সে অঙ্গ-বাতাসে রঙ্গিণীর অঙ্গ কাঁপে ॥ ১৩৭+১ ॥

basilā sundarī saba prabhura samīpe |
se aṅga-bātāse raṅgiṇīra aṅga kāṁpe || 137+1 ||

basila sundari saba — all the beauties sat; prabhura samipe — near the Lord; se anga-batase — at the breeze of that body; ranginira anga kape — the bodies of the playful women tremble

137+1All the beauties sat down near the Lord;12
at the breeze from His body the bodies of the playful women tremble.

বসন বচন সব স্খলিত হইল ।
নয়ান আলস-যুত কাহারো হইল ॥ ১৩৭+২ ॥

basana bacana saba skhalita haila |
naẏāna ālasa-yuta kāhāro haila || 137+2 ||

vasana vachana saba — the garments and speech of all; skhalita haila — began to slip; nayana alasa-yuta — eyes heavy with languor; kaharo haila — became in some

137+2The garments and the speech of all began to slip,
and the eyes of some grew heavy with languor.

কেহ অঙ্গ-পরশে অনঙ্গ-রঙ্গ-ভরে ।
ঢুলিয়া পড়িলা বিশ্বম্ভরের উপরে ॥ ১৩৭+৩ ॥

keha aṅga-paraśe anaṅga-raṅga-bhare |
ḍhuliẏā paṛilā biśbambharera upare || 137+3 ||

keha — one; anga-parashe — touching [His] body; ananga-ranga-bhare — overcome by Ananga's play; dhuliya padila — sank down; vishvambharera upare — upon Vishvambhara

137+3One, touching His body, in the waves of Ananga's play
sank down powerless upon Vishvambhara.

কেহো অনিমিষে থির-নয়নে নিরীখে ।
চকোর চাঁদের লাগি যেন রহে সুখে ॥ ১৩৭+৪ ॥

keho animiṣe thira-naẏane nirīkhe |
cakora cāṁdera lāgi yena rahe sukhe || 137+4 ||

keho — another; animishe — unblinking; thira-nayane nirikhe — gazes with fixed eyes; chakora — the chakora bird; chandera lagi — for the moon; yena rahe sukhe — as if remains blissful

137+4Another, unblinking, gazes at Him with a fixed look —
as the chakora is blissful gazing at the moon.

নয়ন-পঙ্কজে সবে গোরা-মুখ পূজে ।
নিজদেহ-পরশ লাগিয়া কেহো যাচে ॥ ১৩৭+৫ ॥

naẏana-paṅkaje sabe gorā-mukha pūje |
nijadeha-paraśa lāgiẏā keho yāce || 137+5 ||

nayana-pankaje — with the lotuses of the eyes; sabe — all; gora-mukha puje — worship Gora's face; nijadeha-parasha lagiya — for a touch upon herself; keho yache — one begs

137+5With the lotuses of their eyes all worship Gora's face;
one begs for His touch upon herself.

পরাধীন রঙ্ক যেন মহাধন পাইয়া ।
সম্বরিতে নাহি ঠাঁই ছাড়িতে নারে মায়া ॥ ১৩৭+৬ ॥

parādhīna raṅka yena mahādhana pāiẏā |
sambarite nāhi ṭhāṁi chāṛite nāre māẏā || 137+6 ||

paradhina ranka — a dependent pauper; yena — as if; mahadhana paiya — finding great wealth; sambarite nahi thai — has nowhere to hide it; chhadite nare — cannot let go; maya — out of attachment

137+6Like a dependent pauper who has found great wealth —
there is nowhere to hide it, yet out of attachment he cannot let it go.

নাম-বিপর্যয় কেহ করে বাসরঘরে ।
বিশ্বম্ভর-গুণে ভোরা পরিহাস করে ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

nāma-biparyaẏa keha kare bāsaraghare |
biśbambhara-guṇe bhorā parihāsa kare || 138 ||

nama-viparyaya — the changing of names (a game); keha kare — some start; basara-ghare — in the bridal chamber; vishvambhara-gune bhora — enraptured by Vishvambhara's virtues; parihasa kare — they jest

138In the bridal chamber some start the game of changing names;
enraptured by Vishvambhara's virtues, they jest.

কেহ বোলে বিশ্বম্ভর শুন মোর বোল ।
গুয়াখানি দেহ লক্ষ্মী নিদে হৈল ভোর ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

keha bole biśbambhara śuna mora bola |
guẏākhāni deha lakṣmī nide haila bhora || 139 ||

keha bole — one says; vishvambhara shuna mora bola — Vishvambhara, listen to me; guyakhani deha — give a betel nut; lakshmi nide haila bhora — Lakshmi is overcome with sleep

139One says: "Vishvambhara, listen to me:
give a betel nut — Lakshmi is overcome with sleep.

আপনে তুলিয়া দেহ লখিমী-বদনে ।
দেখুক সকল সখী হরষিত-মনে ॥ ১৪০ ॥

āpane tuliẏā deha lakhimī-badane |
dekhuka sakala sakhī haraṣita-mane || 140 ||

apane tuliya deha — put it Yourself; lakhimi-badane — into Lakshmi's mouth; dekhuka sakala sakhi — let all the friends see; harashita-mane — with delight

140Put it into Lakshmi's mouth Yourself —
let all her friends watch with delight!"

বিশ্বম্ভর-কেশ কেহ আউলাইয়া বান্ধে ।
বন্ধন-আকূতি তার পরশের সাধে ॥ ১৪০+১ ॥

biśbambhara-keśa keha āulāiẏā bāndhe |
bandhana-ākūti tāra paraśera sādhe || 140+1 ||

vishvambhara-kesha — Vishvambhara's hair; keha — one; aulaiya bandhe — loosening, binds; bandhana-akuti tara — her eagerness to bind; parashera sadhe — from longing for the touch

140+1One loosens Vishvambhara's hair and binds it again —
her eagerness to bind it comes from her longing to touch [Him].13

কেহো গুয়াখানি দেয় গোরাচাঁদের মুখে ।
হিয়া দরদর তার পায় বড় সুখে ॥ ১৪০+২ ॥

keho guẏākhāni deẏa gorācāṁdera mukhe |
hiẏā daradara tāra pāẏa baṛa sukhe || 140+2 ||

keho — another; guyakhani deya — gives a betel nut; gorachandera mukhe — into Gorachand's mouth; hiya daradara tara — her heart trembles; paya bada sukhe — feels great bliss

140+2Another puts a betel nut into Gorachand's mouth —
her heart trembles, she feels great bliss.

অঙ্গ ঢলি পড়ে কেহো হিয়া উতরোল ।
লক্ষ্মীরে তুলিয়া দেয় গোরাচাঁদের কোল ॥ ১৪০+৩ ॥

aṅga ḍhali paṛe keho hiẏā utarola |
lakṣmīre tuliẏā deẏa gorācāṁdera kola || 140+3 ||

anga dhali pade — sways and sinks; keho — another; hiya utarola — her heart in tumult; lakshmire tuliya — lifting Lakshmi; deya gorachandera kola — places on Gorachand's lap

140+3Another, swaying faint, her heart in a tumult,
lifts Lakshmi and places her on Gorachand's lap.

কেহ বোলে হেন ভাগ্যবতী কে বা আছে ।
বিশ্বম্ভর হেন পতি মিলিয়াছে কাছে ॥ ১৪১ ॥

keha bole hena bhāgyabatī ke bā āche |
biśbambhara hena pati miliẏāche kāche || 141 ||

keha bole — another says; hena bhagyavati ke va achhe — who is so fortunate; vishvambhara hena pati — a husband like Vishvambhara; miliyachhe kachhe — has come to her

141Another says: "Is anyone more fortunate than she?
She has gained a husband like Vishvambhara!

কোন্ তপ কৈল কোন্ কৈল ব্রত-দান ।
দেব-আরাধনে কিবা সাধিল ধেয়ান ॥ ১৪২ ॥

kon tapa kaila kon kaila brata-dāna |
deba-ārādhane kibā sādhila dheẏāna || 142 ||

kon tapa kaila — what austerity did she perform; kon kaila vrata-dana — what vows and gifts; deva-aradhane — in the worship of the gods; kiva sadhila dheyana — what meditation did she perfect

142What austerity did she perform, what vows, what gifts?
What meditation did she perfect in the worship of the gods?

কোন্ সতী পতিব্রতা আছে পৃথিবীতে ।
বিশ্বম্ভর-রূপ দেখি স্থির করু চিতে ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

kon satī patibratā āche pṛthibīte |
biśbambhara-rūpa dekhi sthira karu cite || 143 ||

kon sati pati-vrata — what chaste, faithful wife; achhe prithivite — is there on earth; vishvambhara-rupa dekhi — seeing Vishvambhara's beauty; sthira karu chite — could keep her heart steady

143What faithful, chaste wife on earth
could keep her heart steady on seeing Vishvambhara's beauty?

মদন-সদন জিনি বদন সুন্দর ।
মানিনীর মানস-রতন-বর-চোর ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

madana-sadana jini badana sundara |
māninīra mānasa-ratana-bara-cora || 144 ||

madana-sadana jini — surpassing Madana's abode; badana sundara — the beautiful face; maninira manasa-ratana — of the jewel of a proud beauty's heart; bara-chora — the great thief

144His beautiful face surpasses Madana's abode;
He is the thief of the finest jewel — a proud beauty's heart.

ভুজদণ্ড অখণ্ড যে কামদণ্ড জিনি ।
সাধ করে নিজবুকে ধরিতে রমণী ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

bhujadaṇḍa akhaṇḍa ye kāmadaṇḍa jini |
sādha kare nijabuke dharite ramaṇī || 145 ||

bhujadanda akhanda — the mighty arms; ye kamadanda jini — surpassing the staff of Kama; sadha kare — long; nija-buke dharite — to clasp to their breasts; ramani — women

145His mighty arms surpass the staff of Kama:
women long to clasp them to their breasts.

লখিমী এ সব অঙ্গ বিলাস করিব ।
আমরা ইহার কবে পরশ পাইব ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

lakhimī e saba aṅga bilāsa kariba |
āmarā ihāra kabe paraśa pāiba || 146 ||

lakhimi — Lakshmi; e saba anga — all this body; vilasa kariba — will enjoy; amara — we; ihara kabe parasha paiba — when shall we gain His touch

146Lakshmi will delight in all this body —
but when shall we be blessed with His touch?

এই আমাদের আশা হ'ব ইহার দাসী ।
ক'বে সে সেবিব মোরা শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গ-শশী ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

ei āmādera āśā ha'ba ihāra dāsī |
ka'be se sebiba morā śrīgaurāṅga-śaśī || 147 ||

ei amadera asha — this is our hope; haba ihara dasi — we shall become His maidservants; kabe se sebiba mora — when shall we serve; sri-gauranga-shashi — Sri Gauranga, the moon

147This is our hope: to become His maidservants;
when shall we serve Sri Gauranga, who is like the moon?"14

Raga varadi; disha: "My life, O Gorachand, are haya!"

এই মনে রঙ্গে-ঢঙ্গে প্রভাত হইল ।
প্রাতঃক্রিয়া কৈল প্রভু যে বিধি আছিল ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

ei mane raṅge-ḍhaṅge prabhāta haila |
prātaḥkriẏā kaila prabhu ye bidhi āchila || 148 ||

ei mane — thus; range-dhange — in amusement and merriment; prabhata haila — morning came; pratah-kriya kaila prabhu — the Lord performed the morning rites; ye vidhi achhila — as was prescribed

148Thus, in amusement and merriment, morning came;
the Lord performed the morning rites as prescribed.

বিবাহের পর দিনে কুশণ্ডিকা-কর্ম ।
ব্রাহ্মণ ভোজন করে ব্রাহ্মণের ধর্ম ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

bibāhera para dine kuśaṇḍikā-karma |
brāhmaṇa bhojana kare brāhmaṇera dharma || 149 ||

vibahera para dine — on the day after the wedding; kushandika-karma — the rite of kushandika; brahmana bhojana kare — brahmanas are fed; brahmanera dharma — as befits brahmanas

149On the day after the wedding came the rite of kushandika;
brahmanas are fed, as befits brahmanas.

সকল করিল প্রভু সে দিন তথায় ।
আর দিনে ঘর যাব কহিল কথায় ॥ ১৫০ ॥

sakala karila prabhu se dina tathāẏa |
āra dine ghara yāba kahila kathāẏa || 150 ||

sakala karila prabhu — the Lord did all this; se dina tathaya — that day there; ara dine ghara yaba — tomorrow I shall go home; kahila kathaya — He said

150The Lord performed all this there that day
and said: "Tomorrow I shall go home."

ঘরেরে চলিল প্রভু আনন্দিত মনে ।
পরিজনে পূজা করে রজত-কাঞ্চনে ॥ ১৫১ ॥

gharere calila prabhu ānandita mane |
parijane pūjā kare rajata-kāñcane || 151 ||

gharere chalila prabhu — the Lord set out for home; anandita mane — with a joyful heart; parijane puja kare — the family honour [Him]; rajata-kanchane — with silver and gold

151The Lord set out for home with a joyful heart;
the family honour Him with silver and gold.

একাসনে বৈসে প্রভু লক্ষ্মী বামপাশে ।
চৌদিগে বেঢ়িল নারীগণ তার কাছে ॥ ১৫২ ॥

ekāsane baise prabhu lakṣmī bāmapāśe |
caudige beṛhila nārīgaṇa tāra kāche || 152 ||

ekasane baise prabhu — the Lord sits on one seat; lakshmi vama-pashe — Lakshmi at His left; chaudige bedhila — all around surrounded; narigana tara kachhe — the women near them

152The Lord sits on one seat with Lakshmi at His left;
all around, the women surrounded them.

বল্লভমিশ্রের হিয়া হরিষ-বিষাদ ।
যাত্রাকালে করে কন্যা-বরে আশীর্বাদ ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

ballabhamiśrera hiẏā hariṣa-biṣāda |
yātrākāle kare kanyā-bare āśīrbāda || 153 ||

vallabha-mishrera hiya — in Vallabha Mishra's heart; harisha-vishada — joy and sorrow; yatra-kale — at the departure; kare kanya-bare ashirvada — he blesses bride and bridegroom

153In Vallabha Mishra's heart are joy and sorrow;
at the departure he blesses bride and bridegroom.

দূর্বা ধান্য গন্ধ মাল্য গুবাক চন্দন ।
জামাতারে দিয়া কিছু করে নিবেদন ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

dūrbā dhānya gandha mālya gubāka candana |
jāmātāre diẏā kichu kare nibedana || 154 ||

durva dhanya gandha malya gubaka chandana — durva grass, rice, scents, garlands, betel nuts, sandal; jamatare diya — giving to his son-in-law; kichhu kare nivedana — makes this submission

154Offering durva grass, rice, scents, garlands, betel nuts and sandal,
he speaks to his son-in-law these words:

ধনহীন আমি ছার নাহি করি ভাগ্য ।
কি দিব তোমারে দান কিবা তোর যোগ্য ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

dhanahīna āmi chāra nāhi kari bhāgya |
ki diba tomāre dāna kibā tora yogya || 155 ||

dhana-hina ami chhara — I am poor and wretched; nahi kari bhagya — I have no fortune; ki diba tomare dana — what gift shall I give You; kiva tora yogya — what is worthy of You

155"I am poor and wretched, I have no good fortune;
what gift can I give You — what is worthy of You?

কেবল আপনগুণে কৈলে অনুগ্রহ ।
ধন্য করাইলে করি কন্যা-পরিগ্রহ ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

kebala āpanaguṇe kaile anugraha |
dhanya karāile kari kanyā-parigraha || 156 ||

kebala apana-gune — only by Your own goodness; kaile anugraha — You showed grace; dhanya karaile — You made [me] blessed; kari kanya-parigraha — by accepting my daughter

156Only by Your own goodness have You shown me grace:
by accepting my daughter You have made me blessed.

তোরে কি বলিব প্রভু কি আছে যোগ্যতা ।
আপনার নিজগুণে আমার জামাতা ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

tore ki baliba prabhu ki āche yogyatā |
āpanāra nijaguṇe āmāra jāmātā || 157 ||

tore ki baliba prabhu — what shall I say to You, Lord; ki achhe yogyata — what worth is there [in me]; apanara nija-gune — by Your own goodness; amara jamata — [You are] my son-in-law

157What can I say to You, Lord — what worth have I?
Only by Your own goodness have You become my son-in-law.

তোমার অভয় পাদপদ্মেতে শরণ ।
লভিলে না দিবে দুঃখ আমারে শমন ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

tomāra abhaẏa pādapadmete śaraṇa |
labhile nā dibe duḥkha āmāre śamana || 158 ||

tomara abhaya pada-padmete sharana — refuge at Your fearless lotus feet; labhile — having obtained; na dibe duhkha amare shamana — Yama will not give me pain

158Having found refuge at Your lotus feet, which grant fearlessness,
I shall no longer suffer at the hands of Yama.

দেব-পিতৃগণ মোরে প্রসন্ন হইল ।
যখনে তোমারে নিজ কন্যা সমর্পিল ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

deba-pitṛgaṇa more prasanna haila |
yakhane tomāre nija kanyā samarpila || 159 ||

deva-pitrigana — the gods and ancestors; more prasanna haila — became pleased with me; yakhane — when; tomare nija kanya samarpila — I gave You my daughter

159The gods and the ancestors are pleased with me
since I gave You my daughter.

যে পদ ধেয়ানে পূজে ব্রহ্মা-শিব-আদি ।
সে পদ পূজিল বিদ্যমানে যথাবিধি ॥ ১৬০ ॥

ye pada dheẏāne pūje brahmā-śiba-ādi |
se pada pūjila bidyamāne yathābidhi || 160 ||

ye pada dheyane puje — the feet which in meditation are worshipped by; brahma-shiva-adi — Brahma, Shiva and others; se pada pujila — those feet I worshipped; vidyamane — in person; yatha-vidhi — as prescribed

160The feet which Brahma, Shiva and others worship in meditation —
those feet I have worshipped in person, as prescribed.

আর কিছু নিবেদিয়ে শুন বিশ্বম্ভর ।
এ বোল বলিতে কণ্ঠে গদগদস্বর ॥ ১৬১ ॥

āra kichu nibediẏe śuna biśbambhara |
e bola balite kaṇṭhe gadagadasbara || 161 ||

ara kichhu nivediye — I submit something more; shuna vishvambhara — listen, Vishvambhara; e bola balite — saying this; kanthe gadgada-svara — his voice faltered

161I shall say something more — listen, Vishvambhara."
As he said this, his voice faltered.

ছলছল করে আঁখি করুণার জলে ।
লক্ষ্মী-কর ধরি দিল বিশ্বম্ভর-করে ॥ ১৬২ ॥

chalachala kare āṁkhi karuṇāra jale |
lakṣmī-kara dhari dila biśbambhara-kare || 162 ||

chhalachhala kare ankhi — the eyes brimmed; karunara jale — with tears of tenderness; lakshmi-kara dhari — taking Lakshmi's hand; dila vishvambhara-kare — placed it in Vishvambhara's hand

162His eyes brimmed with tears of tenderness;
taking Lakshmi's hand, he placed it in Vishvambhara's hand.

আজি হৈতে লক্ষ্মী তোরে কৈলুঁ সমর্পণ ।
জানিঞা করিবে ইহার ভরণ-পালন ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

āji haite lakṣmī tore kailuṁ samarpaṇa |
jāniñā karibe ihāra bharaṇa-pālana || 163 ||

aji haite — from this day; lakshmi tore kailun samarpana — I entrust Lakshmi to You; janina — knowing; karibe ihara bharana-palana — You will care for and protect her

163"From this day I entrust Lakshmi to You;
knowing [all this], care for her and protect her.

মোর ঘরে ছিলা লক্ষ্মী ঘরের ঈশ্বরী ।
আজি হৈতে তোর দাসী কুলের বহুড়ী ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

mora ghare chilā lakṣmī gharera īśbarī |
āji haite tora dāsī kulera bahuṛī || 164 ||

mora ghare chhila lakshmi — in my house Lakshmi was; gharera ishvari — the mistress of the house; aji haite — from this day; tora dasi — Your maidservant; kulera bahudi — the daughter-in-law of the family

164In my house Lakshmi was the mistress of the house;
from this day she is Your maidservant, the daughter-in-law of Your family.

মোর ঘরে ছিল এই স্বচ্ছন্দ-আচারে ।
আখটি করিয়া মায়ে করিত আহারে ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

mora ghare chila ei sbacchanda-ācāre |
ākhaṭi kariẏā māẏe karita āhāre || 165 ||

mora ghare chhila ei — in my house she lived; svachchhanda-achare — as she pleased; akhati kariya — being stubborn; maye karita ahare — [made] her mother feed her

165In my house she lived as she pleased:
she would be stubborn until her mother fed her [herself].

মোর ঘরে আছিল এ মা-বাপের কোলে ।
যথা তথা হৈতে আইলে ধরেসিয়া গলে ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

mora ghare āchila e mā-bāpera kole |
yathā tathā haite āile dharesiẏā gale || 166 ||

mora ghare achhila e — in my house she grew; ma-bapera kole — in her mother's and father's arms; yatha tatha haite aile — when we came from anywhere; dharesiya gale — she hung on our necks

166In my house she grew up in her mother's and father's arms;
wherever we came back from, she would throw her arms round our necks.

সভার দুলালী লক্ষ্মী আমি অপুত্রকা ।
ঘরমধ্যে সবে মোর এইটি বালিকা ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

sabhāra dulālī lakṣmī āmi aputrakā |
gharamadhye sabe mora eiṭi bālikā || 167 ||

sabhara dulali lakshmi — Lakshmi is everyone's darling; ami aputraka — I am sonless; ghara-madhye — in the house; sabe mora eiti balika — I have only this little girl

167Lakshmi is everyone's darling; I have no son —
in all my house I have only this one little girl.

আমি কি বলিব এই তোর নিজজন ।
মোহে মুগ্ধ হঞা বলি যতেক বচন ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

āmi ki baliba ei tora nijajana |
mohe mugdha hañā bali yateka bacana || 168 ||

ami ki baliba — what shall I say; ei tora nija-jana — she is Your own; mohe mugdha hana — bewildered by attachment; bali yateka bachana — I speak all these words

168But what am I saying — she is Your own.
All that I say I say blinded by attachment.

এই যে বলিল সেই আমি মূঢ়মতি ।
কি করিব মোর মায়া তুমি যার পতি ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

ei ye balila sei āmi mūṛhamati |
ki kariba mora māẏā tumi yāra pati || 169 ||

ei ye balila — all this I said; sei ami mudha-mati — I, foolish-minded; ki kariba mora maya — what can my attachment do; tumi yara pati — [when] You are her husband

169All this I have said out of my foolishness:
what does my attachment matter, when You are her husband?15

ত্রিভুবনে নাহি লক্ষ্মীসম ভাগ্যবতী ।
আমি যত বলি সেই এ মোহ-পিরীতি ॥ ১৭০ ॥

tribhubane nāhi lakṣmīsama bhāgyabatī |
āmi yata bali sei e moha-pirīti || 170 ||

tribhuvane — in the three worlds; nahi lakshmi-sama bhagyavati — none as fortunate as Lakshmi; ami yata bali — all that I say; sei e moha-piriti — is from attachment and love

170In the three worlds no one is as fortunate as Lakshmi;
all that I say comes only from love and attachment."

এতেক বলিয়া মিশ্র কৈল সম্বরণ ।
ঢলঢল সকরুণ অরুণ-নয়ন ॥ ১৭১ ॥

eteka baliẏā miśra kaila sambaraṇa |
ḍhalaḍhala sakaruṇa aruṇa-naẏana || 171 ||

eteka baliya — having said this; mishra kaila samvarana — Mishra fell silent; dhaladhala — brimming; sakaruna — sorrowful; aruna-nayana — reddened eyes

171Having said this, Mishra fell silent;
his reddened eyes were brimming with tears of sorrow.

চলিলা সে বিশ্বম্ভর নিজপ্রিয়া বামে ।
লক্ষ্মীর সহিত চড়ে মনুষ্যের যানে ॥ ১৭২ ॥

calilā se biśbambhara nijapriẏā bāme |
lakṣmīra sahita caṛe manuṣyera yāne || 172 ||

chalila se vishvambhara — Vishvambhara set out; nija-priya vame — with His beloved at His left; lakshmira sahita — with Lakshmi; chade manushyera yane — mounts the palanquin (carried by men)

172And Vishvambhara set out, with His beloved at His left:
together with Lakshmi He mounted the palanquin.16

শঙ্খ-দুন্দুভি বাজে জয়-জয়-রোল ।
নানাবিধ বাদ্য বাজে আনন্দ-হিল্লোল ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

śaṅkha-dundubhi bāje jaẏa-jaẏa-rola |
nānābidha bādya bāje ānanda-hillola || 173 ||

shankha-dundubhi baje — conchs and dundubhis sound; jaya-jaya-rola — cries of "Jaya, jaya!"; nanavidha vadya baje — all kinds of instruments play; ananda-hillola — waves of joy

173Conchs and dundubhis sound, cries of "Jaya, jaya!" resound;
all kinds of instruments play, joy spreads in waves.

ব্রাহ্মণেতে বেদ পড়ে ভাটে রায়বার ।
সম্মুখে নাটুয়া নাচে আনন্দ অপার ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

brāhmaṇete beda paṛe bhāṭe rāẏabāra |
sammukhe nāṭuẏā nāce ānanda apāra || 174 ||

brahmanete veda pade — brahmanas recite the Vedas; bhate rayabara — bards [sing] praise songs; sammukhe natuya nache — in front dancers dance; ananda apara — boundless joy

174Brahmanas recite the Vedas, bhat bards sing songs of praise;
in front the dancers dance — the joy is boundless.

বয়স্য-বেষ্টিত প্রভু চলি যায় পথে ।
অন্তরীক্ষে দেবগণ চলে দিব্যরথে ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

baẏasya-beṣṭita prabhu cali yāẏa pathe |
antarīkṣe debagaṇa cale dibyarathe || 175 ||

vayasya-veshtita prabhu — the Lord surrounded by friends; chali yaya pathe — goes along the road; antarikshe devagana — in the sky the gods; chale divya-rathe — move in divine chariots

175Surrounded by His friends, the Lord travels along the road;
in the sky the gods follow in divine chariots.

এথা শচী আনন্দিত আইহ-সুহ লৈয়া ।
পুত্র-মহোৎসবে বুলে কৌতুক করিয়া ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

ethā śacī ānandita āiha-suha laiẏā |
putra-mahotsabe bule kautuka kariẏā || 176 ||

etha shachi anandita — here Shachi, joyful; aiha-suha laiya — with the married women; putra-mahotsave — at her son's festival; bule kautuka kariya — goes about merrily

176Meanwhile Shachi, joyful, gathering the married women,
bustles about merrily at her son's festival.

সশাখ মঙ্গলঘট পাতিল দুয়ারে ।
নারিকেল-ফল দিল তাহার উপরে ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

saśākha maṅgalaghaṭa pātila duẏāre |
nārikela-phala dila tāhāra upare || 177 ||

sashakha mangala-ghata — the auspicious pitcher with sprigs; patila duyare — set at the door; narikela-phala dila — placed a coconut; tahara upare — on top of it

177At the door she set an auspicious pitcher with sprigs of leaves
and placed a coconut on top of it.

নির্মঞ্ছন-সজ্জ আর ঘৃত-বাতি জ্বলে ।
ঘরেরে আইলা প্রভু সেই শুভকালে ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

nirmañchana-sajja āra ghṛta-bāti jbale |
gharere āilā prabhu sei śubhakāle || 178 ||

nirmanchhana-sajja — the things for the nirmanchhana; ara ghrita-bati jvale — and ghee lamps burn; gharere aila prabhu — the Lord came home; sei shubha-kale — at that auspicious hour

178All is ready for the nirmanchhana, lamps of ghee are burning;
at that auspicious hour the Lord arrived home.

বিশ্বম্ভর-নির্মঞ্ছন করে নারীগণ ।
জয় জয় হুলাহুলি সুগীত নাচন ॥ ১৭৯ ॥

biśbambhara-nirmañchana kare nārīgaṇa |
jaẏa jaẏa hulāhuli sugīta nācana || 179 ||

vishvambhara-nirmanchhana — Vishvambhara's nirmanchhana; kare narigana — the women perform; jaya jaya — "Jaya, jaya!"; hulahuli — "ulu-ulu" cries; sugita nachana — fine songs and dancing

179The women perform Vishvambhara's nirmanchhana;17
cries of "Jaya, jaya!", "ulu-ulu", fine songs and dancing.

নানাবিধ বাদ্য বাজে আনন্দ অপার ।
সর্বসুখময় হৈল শচীর আগার ॥ ১৮০ ॥

nānābidha bādya bāje ānanda apāra |
sarbasukhamaẏa haila śacīra āgāra || 180 ||

nanavidha vadya baje — all kinds of instruments play; ananda apara — boundless joy; sarva-sukhamaya haila — became full of every happiness; shachira agara — Shachi's house

180All kinds of instruments play, the joy is boundless;
Shachi's house was filled with every happiness.

উঠিল মঙ্গলধ্বনি আনন্দ বিশেষ ।
লক্ষ্মী-কর ধরি নিজগৃহে পরবেশ ॥ ১৮১ ॥

uṭhila maṅgaladhbani ānanda biśeṣa |
lakṣmī-kara dhari nijagṛhe parabeśa || 181 ||

uthila mangala-dhvani — auspicious cries arose; ananda vishesha — special joy; lakshmi-kara dhari — taking Lakshmi's hand; nija-grihe paravesha — entered His home

181Auspicious cries arose, the joy was great;
taking Lakshmi by the hand, [the Lord] entered His home.

পুত্র আর বধূ কোলে করে শচীদেবী ।
দূর্বা-ধান্য দিয়া বোলে হও চিরজীবী ॥ ১৮২ ॥

putra āra badhū kole kare śacīdebī |
dūrbā-dhānya diẏā bole hao cirajībī || 182 ||

putra ara badhu — her son and daughter-in-law; kole kare shachidevi — Shachi-devi embraces; durva-dhanya diya — giving durva grass and rice; bole hao chirajivi — says: "Live long!"

182Shachi-devi embraces her son and daughter-in-law;
showering them with durva grass and rice, she says: "Live long!"

পুত্রমুখে চুম্ব দেই বধূপানে চাঞা ।
বধূমুখে চুম্ব দেই পুত্র নিরখিয়া ॥ ১৮৩ ॥

putramukhe cumba dei badhūpāne cāñā |
badhūmukhe cumba dei putra nirakhiẏā || 183 ||

putra-mukhe chumba dei — she kisses her son's face; badhu-pane chana — looking at the daughter-in-law; badhu-mukhe chumba dei — she kisses the daughter-in-law's face; putra nirakhiya — gazing at her son

183She kisses her son's face, looking at her daughter-in-law,
and kisses her daughter-in-law's face, gazing at her son.

সর্বসুখময় হৈল শচীর আবাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১৮৪ ॥

sarbasukhamaẏa haila śacīra ābāsa |
gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 184 ||

sarva-sukhamaya haila — became full of every happiness; shachira avasa — Shachi's dwelling; gora-guna gaya sukhe — joyfully sings Gora's virtues; e lochana-dasa — this Lochana Dasa

184Shachi's dwelling was filled with every happiness;
joyfully Lochana Dasa sings of Gora's virtues.18

Raga sindhura

এইমতে নিজ-বান্ধব-সহিত,
সুখে নিবসয়ে পহুঁ ।
শচীর অন্তরে, আনন্দ-পাথার,
দেখি গোরাচান্দ বহু ॥ ১৮৪+১ ॥

eimate nija-bāndhaba-sahita,
sukhe nibasaẏe pahuṁ |
śacīra antare, ānanda-pāthāra,
dekhi gorācānda bahu || 184+1 ||

eimate — thus; nija-bandhava-sahita — with His own friends and kin; sukhe nivasaye pahun — the Lord dwells happily; shachira antare — in Shachi's heart; ananda-pathara — an ocean of bliss; dekhi — seeing; gorachanda bahu — Gorachand [and His] bride

184+1Thus the Lord lives happily
with His friends and kinsmen;
in Shachi's heart is an ocean of bliss
as she sees Gorachand with His bride.19

নদীয়া-বিনোদ গোরা,
কেলি-কুতূহলে ভোরা ।
কামের কামান, ভুরু-নিরমাণ,
বাণ কটাক্ষ তারা ॥ ১৮৪+২ ॥

nadīẏā-binoda gorā,
keli-kutūhale bhorā |
kāmera kāmāna, bhuru-niramāṇa,
bāṇa kaṭākṣa tārā || 184+2 ||

nadiya-vinoda gora — Gora, the delight of Nadia; keli-kutuhale bhora — absorbed in the joy of play; kamera kamana — Kama's bow; bhuru-niramana — fashioned of the brows; bana — the arrows; kataksha tara — the glances of the pupils

184+2Gora, the delight of Nadia,
absorbed in the joy of play;
His brows are Kama's bow,
the arrows are the glances of His eyes.

বয়স্যের সঙ্গ, রহস্য-বিলাস,
লীলা-রসময় তনু ।
বিনি মেঘে মহী, এ থির বিজুরী,
তেজল কুসুম-ধনু ॥ ১৮৪+৩ ॥

baẏasyera saṅga, rahasya-bilāsa,
līlā-rasamaẏa tanu |
bini meghe mahī, e thira bijurī,
tejala kusuma-dhanu || 184+3 ||

bayasyera sanga — the company of friends; rahasya-vilasa — jests and sport; lila-rasamaya tanu — a body full of the rasa of lila; vini meghe mahi — on earth without a cloud; e thira bijuri — this steady lightning; tejala kusuma-dhanu — has thrown down the flower-bow

184+3Among His friends, in jests and sport,
His body full of the rasa of lila;
on earth, without a cloud, a steady lightning:
[Kama] has thrown down his flower-bow.

বয়স্য-অংসে, কর অবলম্বি,
পুঁথি করি বাম হাতে ।
দিবসের অন্তে, সব যূথে যূথে,
সুরধুনী-তট-পথে ॥ ১৮৪+৪ ॥

baẏasya-aṃse, kara abalambi,
puṁthi kari bāma hāte |
dibasera ante, saba yūthe yūthe,
suradhunī-taṭa-pathe || 184+4 ||

bayasya-amse — on a friend's shoulder; kara avalambi — resting the hand; punthi kari bama hate — holding a book in the left hand; divasera ante — at the close of day; saba yuthe yuthe — all in groups; suradhuni-tata-pathe — on the way to the bank of the celestial river

184+4Resting His hand on a friend's shoulder,
a book in His left hand,
at the close of day [He goes]
to the bank of the celestial river.

সুগন্ধি চন্দন, অঙ্গে বিলেপন,
বিনোদ বিনোদ ফোঁটা ।
তাহার সৌরভে, ভ্রমর ভুলে,
ধাওল যুবতী-ঘটা ॥ ১৮৪+৫ ॥

sugandhi candana, aṅge bilepana,
binoda binoda phoṁṭā |
tāhāra saurabhe, bhramara bhule,
dhāola yubatī-ghaṭā || 184+5 ||

sugandhi chandana — fragrant sandal; ange vilepana — anointing the body; vinoda vinoda phonta — a most charming tilaka; tahara saurabhe — at its fragrance; bhramara bhule — the bees are bewildered; dhaola yuvati-ghata — crowds of young women ran

184+5His body anointed with fragrant sandal,
on His brow a most charming tilaka;
at its fragrance the bees are bewildered,
and the young women came running in crowds.

চাঁচর কেশ, বেশের মাধুরী,
হেরিয়া কে ধরে চিত ।
কাছার শোভায়, লোভায় যুবতী,
না মানে গুরুর ভীত ॥ ১৮৪+৬ ॥

cāṁcara keśa, beśera mādhurī,
heriẏā ke dhare cita |
kāchāra śobhāẏa, lobhāẏa yubatī,
nā māne gurura bhīta || 184+6 ||

chanchara kesha — curling hair; beshera madhuri — the sweetness of the attire; heriya — seeing; ke dhare chita — who can hold the heart; kachhara shobhaya — by the beauty of the dress; lobhaya yuvati — the young women are allured; na mane gurura bhita — heed not the fear of elders

184+6His curling hair, the sweetness of His attire —
who, seeing it, can hold back her heart?
Allured by the beauty of His dress, the young women
do not heed the fear of their elders.

নদীয়া-নগরে, নাগর-আগরে,
রসের সাগর সভে ।
গৌরচন্দ্র-লীলা, দেখিয়া ভুলিলা,
দম্ভ চূর গেল তবে ॥ ১৮৪+৭ ॥

nadīẏā-nagare, nāgara-āgare,
rasera sāgara sabhe |
gauracandra-līlā, dekhiẏā bhulilā,
dambha cūra gela tabe || 184+7 ||

nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; nagara-agare — [He] the foremost of nagaras; rasera sagara sabhe — all in an ocean of rasa; gaurachandra-lila — Gaurachandra's lila; dekhiya bhulila — seeing, lost their senses; dambha chura gela tabe — then the pride was ground to dust

184+7In the town of Nadia, where He is the foremost of nagaras,
all are sunk in an ocean of rasa;
seeing Gaurachandra's lila, all lost their senses,
and their pride was ground to dust.

নাগরীর গুণ, আছয়ে বাখান,
বঙ্কিম-আঁখি-কটাক্ষে ।
লাজের মন্দিরে, আগুনি ভেজায়া,
লোভে পড়ে লাখে লাখে ॥ ১৮৪+৮ ॥

nāgarīra guṇa, āchaẏe bākhāna,
baṅkima-āṁkhi-kaṭākṣe |
lājera mandire, āguni bhejāẏā,
lobhe paṛe lākhe lākhe || 184+8 ||

nagarira guna — the nagaris [His] qualities; achhaye bakhana — praise; bankima-ankhi-katakshe — with sidelong glances of curving eyes; lajera mandire — the temple of shame; aguni bhejaya — setting on fire; lobhe pade — fall in longing; lakhe lakhe — by hundreds of thousands

184+8The nagaris praise His qualities
with sidelong glances of curving eyes;
setting fire to the temple of shame,
they fall [to Him] by hundreds of thousands in longing.

নদীয়া-সুন্দরী, আপনা পাসরি,
রহল হিয়া-ধেয়ানে ।
লোচনদাস বলে, সে সুখ-হিল্লোলে,
এই কর অনুমানে ॥ ১৮৪+৯ ॥

nadīẏā-sundarī, āpanā pāsari,
rahala hiẏā-dheẏāne |
locanadāsa bale, se sukha-hillole,
ei kara anumāne || 184+9 ||

nadiya-sundari — the beauties of Nadia; apana pasari — forgetting themselves; rahala hiya-dheyane — remain in meditation in the heart; lochanadasa bale — Lochana Dasa says; se sukha-hillole — in those waves of happiness; ei kara anumane — imagine this

184+9The beauties of Nadia, forgetting themselves,
remain absorbed in meditation [on Him] in their hearts.
Lochana Dasa says: in those waves of happiness —
just imagine this.

✦

Notes

  1. "Chhorla" — the raised wedding platform (under a canopy) where the bridegroom stands and the rite is performed.
  2. "Bar-urati" (in Lochana Dasa, "bara urathite") — the rite of welcoming the bridegroom: the married women, led by the bride's mother, circle him with lamps and bless him.
  3. Godhuli — "the hour of cow-dust", dusk, when the herds come home; in Bengal an auspicious time for a wedding.
  4. Rohini — the beloved consort of the Moon god; cf. Murari 1.10.22.
  5. The meaning of "chhamuni" is unclear (perhaps the covering that hides the faces of bride and groom until the rite of seeing each other); the 1983 edition reads "they left the chhamuni".
  6. When the Lord as Vamana-Trivikrama strode up to Brahma's abode, Brahma washed His foot; cf. Murari 1.10.24.
  7. Vv. 120–128 are in A but absent from the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them in a note as an additional reading of one manuscript.
  8. Lochana Dasa's list of avataras is free: "Hiranyakashipu" apparently stands for the avatara who slew him (Nrisimha), "the mlecchas" for Kalki, who chastises them; Bhrigurama is another name of Parashurama (perhaps Rama of the Raghus was meant); Vyasa is a shaktyavesha-avatara. The sense is clear: all the avataras are portions of Him who appeared as Gauranga; so too the Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition teaches (Gaura is Krishna Himself, the source of all avataras).
  9. Indra, king of the gods, honours the Lord as his master; cf. Murari 1.10.25.
  10. "Pancha-grasi" — the rite of the five mouthfuls: in the bride's house the bridegroom eats five handfuls of food.
  11. Basara — the room where the newly-weds spend the wedding night while the women keep them awake with jests and songs.
  12. Vv. 137+1 – 137+6 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them, partly in brackets. On the nagari-bhava see en/09, note 9; cf. en/18, note 6: Lochana Dasa depicts the attraction of the women of Nadia to Gaura in the language of love poetry, but for a Gaudiya Vaishnava this is not worldly passion but attraction to the Lord, the transcendental Madana. The chakora is a bird which, by poetic tradition, feeds on moonbeams.
  13. Vv. 140+1 – 140+3 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them.
  14. Vv. 136–147 — again Lochana Dasa's motif of nagari-bhava (see en/09, note 9). Still more such lines are in the 1983 edition (vv. 137+1 – 137+6, 140+1 – 140+3).
  15. Here "maya" is Vallabha's own fatherly attachment: before such a husband as the Lord it counts for nothing.
  16. Lit. "a vehicle carried by men".
  17. Nirmanchhana — a rite in which women wave lamps and auspicious articles around the bridegroom to ward off all that is inauspicious.
  18. Cf. Murari 1.10.27, 1.11.1–2.
  19. The song in raga sindhura (vv. 184+1 – 184+9) is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition, where the new section begins at once); the 1903 edition has it. The 1983 edition marks stanza 184+2 as the refrain (dhruva). Vv. 184+4 and 184+6 are partly corrupt in both editions and are translated by sense. "The foremost of nagaras" (184+7) and the stanzas on the nagaris are Lochana Dasa's motif of nagari-bhava (see en/09, note 9).
